title: Account Executive at IT Reseller Sees CoreWeave Gaining Share as AI Workloads and GPU Demand Grow
expert: Field account executive at a large value-added IT reseller (customers with 1,000-10,000 employees); current; first-hand CoreWeave evaluations and practice revenue; commercial, not operational, view; interview 2026-10-15
verdict: A large IT reseller's account executive saw CoreWeave-related business grow about 20%, maybe 17.5% y/y in Q3 2026, with clusters handed over on schedule and effective pricing up an estimated 5%-7%.

Backlog / RPO (demand): 🟢 **Reseller CoreWeave business +17.5%-20% y/y in Q3 2026** (first-hand), with Q4 seen at 18%-20% and CY26 ~20% (estimate); first expert read on this page. → Tenet 1 (backlog conversion) ↑
GPU pricing: 🟡 **Effective pricing +5%-7% y/y** (estimate), well below mgmt's 20%+ increases on older chips (SB #67233) and the ~25% July hike: **conflicting**. → Tenet 4 (pricing) →
Contracted power \u2192 active power con: 🟢 **Cluster handoffs "generally on schedule"**; delays came from customer readiness, not CoreWeave delivery. → Tenet 3 (power ramp) ↑
🔴 **Customers not running at full utilization**, optimizing usage (unquantified), which may slow expansion revenue.
Competition & share: 🟢 **Gaining share in specialised GPU cloud** on GPU availability and performance; hyperscalers remain incumbents for standardised enterprise workloads. → Tenet 6 (supply wave) ↑

changes: Pricing: expert estimates +5%-7% effective y/y vs mgmt's 20%+ increases on older chip models at Citi TMT (SB #67233, 2026-11-03): **conflicting** (lower).
Pricing vs margins: Deutsche Bank understands contribution margins on 2Q deals rose 5-10pts (SB #67240, 2026-11-04): consistent direction (pricing up).
First read on reseller-channel CoreWeave growth (17.5%-20% y/y); no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (backlog conversion): ↑ — reseller CoreWeave business +17.5%-20% y/y as evaluations convert to capacity.
Tenet 3 (power conversion): ↑ — cluster handoffs generally on schedule.
Tenet 4 (pricing inflecting): → — +5%-7% effective y/y, below the ~25% July hike on the page.
Tenet 6 (supply wave / competition): ↑ — gaining share against smaller GPU clouds; hyperscalers still incumbents.
